name: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
description: Every morning, Sakuradaimon-kun enforces the rules at the school gate, stopping Poem-chan for her too-short skirt. But when they’re thrown together in remedial class, she discovers his secret—the serious, uptight Sakuradaimon-kun is hopeless at studying! As they clash, bicker, and stumble through school life together, the two opposites slowly draw closer and form an unexpected friendship.

videos.title: The Class Monitor Is a Klutz/The School Girl's Friends Get Involved with The Klutz/The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Health Representative
videos.overview: Poem learns the nagging class monitor is an idiot who lives nearby. Her friends learn they're growing close.

videos.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Library Assistant/The Time She Spent Lunch With the Klutz
videos.overview: Poem meets the handsome librarian who's mousey when away from his books. Then she looks for her missing lunch.

videos.title: The Older Gal Who's Close to the Klutz/The Student Council of the Klutz's School
videos.overview: A mysterious, sexy gal appears and gets a pass from Togo. The student council raises money for disaster relief.

videos.title: A Day Off with the Klutz/The Klutz Gets Plunged into Battle on the Streets
videos.overview: Togo enjoys breakfast with Poem's mom and little sister. While shopping, he rap-battles and meets her dad.

videos.title: The Klutzy Health Representative and the Schoolgirl Who Slips Often/Taking More Supplementary Lessons with the Klutz on the Day Her Little Sister Is Touring the Klutz's School
videos.overview: Poem and Tasaki try to help Akina hook up with Izubuchi. Togo and Poem's little sisters tour the school.

videos.title: Drawing BL of the Klutz/The Klutz  Studies Diligently/Buying Swimsuits to Hang Out with the Klutz's Friends
videos.overview: Poem sits in on a meeting of the Manga Study Club with Tasaki. Togo, Poem, and her friends study for finals.

videos.title: Having Fun at the Beach With the Klutzes
videos.overview: Togo, Poem, and the others all enjoy a fun time at the beach. Nadeko tries to make Kogori see her as woman.

videos.title: The Klutz Suddenly Had an Earnest Look in His Eyes
videos.overview: The group's journey continues on the beach, and Togo begins to reflect on his bond with the girls.

videos.title: The Klutz and the High School Girl's Summer Break Plus the Start of Their Second Semester
videos.overview: Poem and Togo start dating after his confession, but fail to keep their relationship a secret.

videos.title: The Klutzes Prepare for the Cultural Festival
videos.overview: Prep for the cultural festival is underway, including the prom Akina proposed. Izubuchi shares his past.

videos.title: The Klutzes Enjoy the Cultural Festival
videos.overview: Akina & Bucchi promote the prom, Poem & Togo's dads rap battle, and Kaoru goes on a date with Nadeshiko.

videos.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
videos.overview: The prom kicks off and a couple is crowned. Poem confronts Togo. Izubuchi searches for the man who saved him.
